in_marathi.name: Dhrushti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhrushti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dṛṣṭi’, meaning ‘sight’ or ‘vision’. In Hindu mythology, Dhrushti is the goddess of sight and the power of perception. She is also known as the divine power of observation and understanding.
